description: Treatment and chemical dosing at the plants of all 58 systems; RS-1 WTP-A, WTP-B, and WTP-C produce up to 210 MGD for about 640,000 people
process_owner: Water Utility chief operating officer (RS-1: RS-1 Director of Operations)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: RS-1 storage covers about 8 hours of average demand while holding fire reserve; unsafe chemical feed or loss of treatment is a public health event and a Tier 1 public notice situation (40 CFR 141.202(a) Table 1 item (7)); RPO covers PLC logic and setpoint configuration
manual_workaround: Local (manual) control of chemical feed, filters, and high-service pumps by licensed operators; hardwired stroke limits and independent analyzer alarms at the 15 largest systems' plants
dependent_people_or_facilities: Licensed operators; 3 RS-1 plants; plants at 57 other systems
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Does not depend on group IT to keep running; depends on SYS-G4 only for remote support

description: Booster stations, wells, and storage tanks that hold pressure across 58 distribution systems

manual_workaround: Local pressure-switch control; roving operators set pumps by hand
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-W1

description: Treatment and pumping at systems still on local SCADA, mostly smaller and staffed by day with on-call operators at night
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Smaller storage and fewer staff; on-call operators rely on remote access to see alarms at night
manual_workaround: Operators on site around the clock during an outage; mutual aid from neighboring regions
dependent_systems: Local SCADA at 19 systems; legacy vendor remote tools
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Not yet behind SYS-G4 or SYS-G2 OT monitoring (gaps 1 and 2)

description: Sign-in, MFA, privileged access, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users; MFA for regional OT directories
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division's IT systems and the 14 regional OT directories depend on SYS-G1 for MFA; plants keep running on local sessions
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; local emergency accounts in each control room

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and passive OT monitoring at the 6 largest water systems
